newsitem.title: USA: GM sets unchanged quarterly dividend.
newsitem.headline: GM sets unchanged quarterly dividend.

text.p: General Motors Corp board of directors declared an unchanged dividend of $0.40 a share on its $1-2/3 par value common stock.
The board also set a quarterly payout of $0.24 a share on GM Class H stock, also unchanged. Both dividends are payable December 10 to shareholders of record on November 14.

The board also declared the following quarterly dividends: $0.570313 per GM Series B depositary share; $0.495 per GM Series D depositary share; and $0.57 per GM Series G depositary share. Those dividends are payable February 1, 1997, to holders of record on January 6, 1997.
